WITH scan_site_join AS (
  SELECT 
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    site.riskeval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites site ON s.zoneref = site.zoneregistry
),
group_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin) as group_rate
  FROM scan_site_join
  GROUP BY riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_rate) as bench_rate
  FROM group_rates
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT group_rate, bench_rate
  FROM group_rates
  CROSS JOIN benchmark
  WHERE group_rate > bench_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(group_rate - bench_rate) as avg_excess
FROM above_benchmark;
